verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a scraping API service, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a hosted API that requires an API key, plus an official CLI and a hosted MCP server, both of which are clients of the hosted service. Community comments about running something locally or open-sourcing a stack describe replacing ScrapingBee, not self-hosting it, so nothing shows a self-hosted deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
